transactions.description: Every movement in every 'Movimientos de ...' section of the statement.

account.description: The name of the account whose section lists this movement, exactly as printed after 'Movimientos de'.

date.description: The date of the transaction in YYYY-MM-DD format.

amount.description: Amount of the transaction, can include decimals.

closing_balances.description: The balance of each account at the end of the period.

account.description: The name of the account, exactly as printed after 'Movimientos de'.

amount.description: The account's balance at the end of the period. null when the statement prints none.
